inspected_integration.finding: QA envelopes report execution metrics without replayable immutable fact scopes; memory hook has no immutable source-version contract.

outputs.usage_scope: Sidecar receipts; never substituted into offline measurements

production_saving_claim.reason: Capture is not an experiment; real paired usage and independent quality outcomes remain absent.

remaining: Paired real calls for each arm, answer-quality evaluation, repeated latency and complete cost accounting.
scope: Explicit caller-owned sequential capture and private export; no real project episode collected.

contracts: Capture/export/replay round-trip retains exact source versions without outcome labels.
Mutable inputs and returned snapshots cannot alter captured facts.
Value and absence changes under one version are rejected atomically.
Null fact and absent fact remain distinct.
Byte/turn/receipt limits preserve prior state; no truncation.
Partial tokens and unknown costs stay unknown; total consistency and cost units checked.
Duplicate tasks/receipt IDs and unsupported tokens_saved fields are rejected.
All-missing episodes export an empty archive and replay as abstentions.
Exclusive private-file writes preserve existing evidence and clean failed new writes.
CLI keeps source content out of stdout/errors and does not create outcomes.
